gym.scope: 16 new gym products. Source/catalog/code untouched. No applications, purchases, communications or publication performed.
facts: Prices are exact listed configurations; manufacturer product JSON used where obtainable. All records affiliate=false; no tracking links, scores or reviews invented.
All 16 local photographs were visually inspected. Images match the equipment; Rogue rack photo contains excluded barbell/plates, labeled in attributes.
Titan feed current price is $759.97, rather than stale $719.97 search result. Bells current 210 lb no-upright variant is $1,299.99, rather than stale indexed $1,315.99.
PowerBlock $977 shown by the indexed page is the 80 lb option. Its embedded exact 100 lb knurled variant is $1,196, includes expansion stages 2–4, available=true.
SOLE listings are the new 2026 F80/E95 generation; prior generations have different dimensions and specs.
inference: The assortment creates comparisons across rowers, bikes, racks, cable trainers and adjustable dumbbells without duplicate variants of existing products. Higher prices alone do not establish commission revenue.
Prioritize Horizon partner qualification: its publicly stated 8% would equal $143.92 on a $1,799 eligible sale before refunds/exclusions. This is arithmetic, not approved or expected revenue.
assumptions: US retail one-time purchases; no geographic taxes, financing, optional installation, extended warranty or paid software included. Indoor placement conservatively used for home gym equipment.
unknowns: No user-specific approved affiliate links exist. Actual acceptance, net eligible orders and commission economics remain unknown.
SOLE F80 2026 exact circuit requirement not confirmed. Current 2026 manual is linked but web retrieval failed; no older-generation electrical requirements substituted.

REP PÉPIN HTML has an apparently incorrect generic technical table (1,000 lb capacity and 9.85 sq ft) inconsistent with dumbbells. It was excluded; record uses model-specific FAQ/description and leaves width/height unconfirmed.
REP Arcadia assembly manual is linked; mandatory floor anchoring could not be confirmed. No freestanding/no-anchor assertion made.

Rogue RML-390F numerical rated load was not confirmed; no capacity inferred from steel gauge. Frame/weld limited-lifetime coverage is stated, but warranty facet omitted because every accessory minimum is not established.
Concept2 RowErg has manufacturer-tested 500 lb and EN20957-7 300 lb limits; attribute preserves both. userCapacity uses the explicitly manufacturer-tested 500 lb value.
Bells cable travel lengths conflict between technical table and FAQ, so no cable-travel claim used. Wall-mount selected for no-back-upright configuration; anchors/install excluded.
PowerBlock and Concept2 direct resized image endpoints failed, but original official image/CDN files succeeded. No synthetic or substitute-product images used.
